encounter_greeting.text: oh no oh no youre an enemy?? sorry i dont know how the sword thing works yet!! ser {player} pls dont hit me :(

released_by_player.text: {player} you let me go?? thank you so much!! i was ready to pay the ransom i think, i had the coin in a sock

{player} you are amazing, i only hit one guy and he fell over by himself. thank you for covering me!!

whisper_beg_help.text: {player} hi!! {enemy_faction} is attacking {fief} and i dont know what to do. could you maybe come help? i will bring snacks

{player} pls dont be mad but {fief} might fall?? {enemy_faction} brought loads. got a spare minute? id be so grateful :)

looking for people to join {my_faction} for a raid on {enemy_faction}!! no experience needed, i have none xD sorry in advance
{my_faction} recruiting for {fief}! we have snacks and one horse-shaped rumour. please come
who wants to join the siege of {fief}?? i promise i wont accidentally recruit you, i already did that to four peasants lol

ambient_chatter.text: does anyone know where the horses are?? i have looked in every stable in {town} and found only goats
the rain in {village} is so pretty, i stood in it for ten minutes and i think im slightly wet now
lag is making me walk backwards, is that normal?? sorry if im being loud i just keep clicking things xD

player_joined_my_faction.text: everyone say hi to {player}, they just joined {my_faction}!! welcome!! i will show you where the good snacks are

encounter_alliance_yes.text: yes yes yes!! an alliance with you {player}?! sure!! i dont totally know what it means but it sounds like we hold hands now xD

{player} yes!! we can fight {enemy_faction} together. sorry if i mess up the plan, i always do the first step wrong

captured_by_player.text: oh no youve got me!! ser {player} please dont put me in a hole, i will pay the {gold} i swear, it is in a sock somewhere
so i am your prisoner now? sorry, i didnt expect to lose so quickly. {my_faction} will pay {gold} for me probably
ser {player} you caught me!! im honestly relieved, i was lost anyway. {gold} is not much but thank you for not hitting me
haha ok {player} you got me. i wasnt even sure which way was forward. the {gold} ransom is my fault for losing, sorry
